notes.title: Version 0.3.3.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with some menu buttons not working when clicked on.
[*] Fixed issue where certain text characters in dungeon names were preventing dungeon from being published to our server.
[*] Slight improvement to enemy AI.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.3.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Menus now have mouse controls.
[*] Fixed login email/nickname being case sensitive
[*] Fixed login email only to email and nickname/username
[*] Fixed input tabing and enter
[*] Fixed misspelling of "Cancle"
[*] Auto pause combat when controller is plugged/unplugged
[*] Now shows if players dungeon has been published in view all tab
[/list]
